svg.title: Measured service mesh echo performance
svg.desc: Four panels show p99 latency, proxy anonymous RSS, proxy CPU, and bulk payload throughput. Small markers are eligible capacity measurements in declared concurrency order. Large ringed markers are separate measured shared-load controls at their actual achieved request rates.
svg.text: Same host · 8 logical CPUs · 3.32 GiB RAM
Shared controls: 10,000 RPS offered to each mesh · concurrency 64 · 1 KiB request / response

g.text: Each marker is a measured capacity point.
1 MiB request + 1 MiB response per exchange.
Payload rate is per direction, not doubled.

svg.text: Only error-free points shown. Lines follow declared concurrency order; they do not add measurements.
Shading is the overlap of measured capacity RPS spans. Ringed controls use actual achieved RPS, not the offered target.
